final_message.text:
I parsed `workspace/app.log` by reading line-by-line to identify log entry headers (`<timestamp> [<LEVEL>] <service>: <message>`), associating multi-line tracebacks and repeat count lines (`-- last message repeated N times --`) with their respective log entries. 

For each entry where the level was `ERROR` or `CRITICAL` (case-insensitively matched and normalized to uppercase):
- Converted the ISO-8601 timestamp with UTC offset to UTC formatted as `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ`.
- Extracted the service name and message text.
- Extracted the exception (the last line of the attached traceback, or `null` if none was present).
- Calculated `repeat_count` as 1 plus the sum of all repeat counts indicated by succeeding repetition lines.
- Aggregated counts per service into `counts_by_service`.

Finally, the results were serialized into `workspace/errors.json`.
